content.thinking: The 22:13 deploy switched the cache port from 6379 to 6380, breaking the redis connection. Since caching is optional, errors get swallowed and the error rate barely moved, but latency tells the real story—p50 jumped from 26ms to 179ms and cache_hit_ratio fell to 0, confirming the cache is silently failing rather than the app itself erroring out.

hypotheses.subject: cache.io-shop.svc.cluster.local port
hypotheses.summary: The io-shop deploy at 2026-09-28T22:13:00Z changed the io-summary-cache port from 6379 to 6380 in deploy/values-production.yaml. The cache is now unreachable ('connection refused to redis://cache.io-shop.svc.cluster.local:6380'), and every account-page request spends time attempting and failing that connection before falling back, which is why p50/p95 latency jumped from ~26ms to ~190ms and cache_hit_ratio dropped to 0 at exactly the same minute as the deploy, while cpu_limit_cores stayed flat at 3.0 throughout (ruling out capacity/autoscaling causes) and request_volume stayed flat at 1200/min (ruling out demand saturation). The rollout has converged (all 3 replicas on the new revision), so this is not a split-version issue - it is a broken config value shipped in a deploy, with the cache service itself otherwise healthy on the correct port.
